findings.current: … many {{completed, number, ::group-off} de completadas} … (same shape in the failed, cancelled and unknown plurals)
findings.problem: The 'many' arms are es-authored (English has no category arms here) and exist because es CLDR puts exact millions in 'many' ('un millón de completadas'). Each one reuses the sibling arms' '::group-off' skeleton, so the only number that can reach it prints ungrouped: rendering completed=1000000 gives "1000000 de completadas". Spanish always groups, and the es style guide's own exemplar for this category is many {# de sesiones}, illustrated as "1.000.000 de sesiones". Verified: many {# de completadas} renders "1.000.000 de completadas". Real but unreachable in practice (>=1,000,000 requests in one sound batch), and a one-commit fix, hence MINOR rather than MAJOR.
findings.suggestion: Use '#' in the four many arms: many {# de completadas}, many {# de fallidas}, many {# de detenidas}, many {# con estado desconocido}. Every other arm keeps the '::group-off' skeleton exactly as English.

findings.problem: This value is also the audio player's accessible name: media-label.ts documents it, and sound-player.tsx composes it into ui.chat.audio.play_label / pause_label / position_label, producing "Reproducir Sonido 2" — a capitalised common noun mid-sentence, an orthography error in Spanish. The visible tile/alt-text surface wants the capital ('Imagen' keeps it for the same reason); the composed accessible name wants lower case. Same trade-off the ru round-3 audit recorded as S16F-RU-R3-01.
findings.suggestion: No change requested now (screen-reader-only, invisible, and the sidecar's tone field asks for a capitalised bare noun). If a later wave decides, change 'Sonido'/'Imagen' together with the audio play/pause/position templates in one commit; never flip this key alone.

findings.problem: 'Charge' has two renderings inside one card: 'cobro' in sound.cost.estimated_zero ('cobro final sin confirmar') and sound.stop.warning ('se cobrará … el cobro'), and 'cargo' here. Reviewed and downgraded from MINOR: the shipped es catalogue already names an unbilled amount 'sin cargo' (ui.chat.session_spend.plan_clause: '…equivalente a API, sin cargo'), so this follows product precedent rather than inventing a term. 'Sin coste.' would be the alternative if card-internal uniformity is ever wanted.
findings.suggestion: No change recommended. Recorded so a later wave does not silently reverse a precedent-backed call, and so my own reversal (MINOR -> NIT on finding the plan_clause precedent) is visible rather than dropped.

considered_and_rejected.observation: Plural carries '=1'/other rather than the full es one+many+other set.
considered_and_rejected.judgement: Not a defect. The English source branches on '=1' only; '=1' matches exactly one and every other count (including es 'many' at 1e6) falls to 'other', which is the numbered form — verified by render (Imagen 1000000). Adding one/many arms would be text-identical ceremony. fr, vi, ur and hi ship the same shape in this PR; only ru expanded it. I concur with the es round-2 receipt (756ed6175781) that the source-derived shape is correct.

considered_and_rejected.observation: has_attention 'yes' renders 'Atención: {labels}' where English says 'Needs attention: {labels}'.
considered_and_rejected.judgement: A verbless warning label is idiomatic es UI and keeps the meaning (the listed items did not complete); 'Necesita atención:' would be a calque. No change.
